verdicts.reason: A breaks the event information: the yellow date card is shrunk to an unreadable speck in the top-right, the body copy is tiny in the top-left corner above the headline, the 'FIZZBANG ARCADE NIGHT' eyebrow is pushed to the very bottom out of reading order, the controller is a scrap in the bottom-left corner, and a huge blow-up of the decorative pattern dominates the middle of the canvas. B is a coherent centred stack (logo, headline, date, copy, CTA) that keeps the brand intact, but the date card is too small so SAT/NOV/8PM-1AM are unreadable, the eyebrow sits below the body copy instead of above the headline, the pattern strip is a cropped sliver, and the controller is shrunk to a token icon.
